sourceTitle: Oven Roasted Potatoes With Hot Chili Sauce
sourceText:
Oven Roasted Potatoes With Hot Chili Sauce
By: Yousef Natsheh
Published: Sunday, April 15, 2012 - 9:53am

Ingredients




1 Kilo potato
½ cup Sweet Chili Sauce OR Hot Chili Sauce
¼ cup corn oil
Large Spoon Pomegranate core
One small spoon salt
Large half spoon white pepper
Large spoon chicken Spices
A large spoon Paprika
One small spoon curry
Promises small rosemary

Preparation

1 Wash potatoes and cut into large pieces as in the picture. 2 In a bowl put the salt and all spices and The Core of Pomegranate  and sweet OR hot chili sauce. 3 Add to the mixture of corn oil . 4 Add all mixtures to the potatoes and mix well. 5 Then Finally enter into the oven at 180 for degree for 20 to 25 minutes. 6 The END Hope You Like It

About

Hi Again How Are You Today Now We Gonna Make A Yummy Oven Roasted Potatoes With Hot Chili Sauce  OR Sweet Chili Sauce As You Like But I Prefer Hot Chili Sauce You Have Choice Its Easy Speedy Recipe And Yummy Too (^__^).
Preparation time: 10 to 20.
Cooking time: 20-30 minutes.
